question: Do the three held GSE329778 matrices qualify when literal empty records are explicitly skipped and counted, and what exact shared-feature/barcode structure is available across the seven deposited multiome libraries?
decision: Resolve a documented parser coverage limitation and consolidate qualified library structure; preserve v1 source results and all biological-design holds.
strongest_rival: Incorrect accession/run correspondence, barcode reuse, unvalidated inferred donors, pooled preparations and mismatched feature sets can create false biological-unit or assay joins.
discriminator: Reconcile literal GEO/BioSample records, article locators, acquired-file hashes, matrix shapes/IDs/shared axes and source-workbook text labels. Metadata consistency cannot establish biological independence, state identity or causal memory.
exposure_record: V1 metadata counts and component holds are exposed. Targeted source inspection found valid explicit six-column feature records alternating with empty LF lines; no modality guessing is needed. No biological endpoint or state assignment has been calculated. New adapter tests use synthetic interleaved-empty records.
biological_unit: Metadata objects are GEO/SRA/BioSample records, deposited pooled-library matrices and barcodes; independent mice/preparations are not yet verified.
nesting_and_overlap: RNA and ATAC may share a matrix barcode axis, while several source sample records can belong to one pooled preparation. Controls occur across multiome runs; cross-run barcode reuse is not longitudinal or animal pairing. Inferred donor groups are not independently validated mouse identities.
population_and_selection: Only the three previously held GSE329778 matrices receive new count-integrity inspection. Four successful HDF5 records are reused from v1, with identifier-only rereads to verify prior fingerprints and cross-format overlaps. No raw biological record is removed; only empty text records are skipped and counted.
contrast: No biological contrast. Reconcile three adapted MatrixMarket records and four previously qualified HDF5 records, then compare exact source feature/barcode availability.
endpoint: Empty/nonempty physical record counts; explicit feature types; validated matrix dimensions, indices/values and coordinate ordering; consolidated library metadata; pairwise feature/barcode overlaps and all-seven exact feature intersection.
methods: METADATA_AMENDMENT_V2.md specifies counted empty/whitespace-only line removal with unchanged source bytes. Preserve every nonempty record and reject malformed types/IDs/dimensions/counts. Stream three MatrixMarket files; reuse prior HDF5 structural evidence and read only IDs/types/barcodes for fingerprint and overlap checks. No source reparsing, dense-table rerun, normalization, feature merging or biological inference.
missingness_and_exclusions: Empty text records alone are ignored and counted; malformed nonempty records remain errors. Missing/unknown modality is never guessed. A local schema failure retains its component hold. Only fully qualified seven-library coverage produces the common-feature-ID table; unknown animal/state/function joins stay unknown.
multiplicity: All predefined metadata records and all pairwise feature/barcode comparisons; no hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, feature ranking or multiplicity correction.
precision_basis: Deterministic source and structure qualification, not population estimation. Dataset size or barcode count does not supply biological replication or precision.
interpretation_limit: Successful metadata execution does not validate independent animals, inferred donor identities, state labels, peak-gene links, TF activity, inflammatory memory or an early-to-later functional join. Biological Q3-Q6 require a separate reviewed estimand and committed contract.
stop_rule: Stop on source/contract hash mismatch, wrong output directory, occupied output artifacts or inconsistent declared source/assay crosswalk. Preserve failed receipts. Local schema/value errors produce named component holds without modifying data. Any current content refusal stops affected dependent scope with exact error; no alternate wording/session or authentication bypass.
amendment_reason: V1 preserved the exact Missing feature-type column holds for GSE329778. Source inspection showed valid explicitly typed records interleaved with empty lines. This pre-execution v2 adapter handles that representation, counts excluded empty records, and retains all original nonempty data. Four passed HDF5 integrity checks and all other v1 source checks are reused; only failed scope is re-inspected.
